name: uttero
title: Uttero
description: Control Uttero voice dictation from Raycast — start dictation, switch styles, and more.
author: daniel_gamrot

commands.name: start-dictation
commands.title: Start Dictation
commands.description: Start voice dictation with the currently selected style.

commands.name: dictate-with-mode
commands.title: Dictate with Mode
commands.description: Pick a style and start dictating immediately.

commands.name: transcript-history
commands.title: Transcript History
commands.description: Browse and copy recent Uttero transcripts.

commands.name: copy-last-transcript
commands.title: Copy Last Transcript
commands.description: Copy the most recent Uttero transcript to the clipboard.

commands.name: insert-last-transcript
commands.title: Insert Last Transcript
commands.description: Insert the most recent dictation transcript at the cursor.

commands.name: select-style
commands.title: Search Styles
commands.description: Choose which Uttero style to use for the next dictation.

commands.name: toggle-offline
commands.title: Toggle Offline Mode
commands.description: Switch Uttero between online (cloud) and offline (on-device) transcription.

commands.name: menu-bar-status
commands.title: Uttero Status
commands.description: Show today's dictation stats in the menu bar.
